classes.name: BuzzCommentAPI
classes.description: This class provides the API endpoints for managing comments on buzz shares. It includes methods for retrieving individual comments, listing comments for a share, creating new comments, editing existing comments, and deleting comments. It handles validation, transaction management, and response formatting.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by comment ID and share ID, returning the comment data in the specified model format.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all comments on a given share, supporting sorting and pagination, returning the collection of comments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a specified share, within a transaction, updating the share's comment count.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing comment if the user has permission, setting new text and updating the timestamp.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a comment if the user has permission, within a transaction, decrementing the share's comment count.

methods.name: setBuzzCommentText
methods.description: Helper method to set the text of a BuzzComment object from request parameters.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which comment model class to use based on the 'model' request parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring IDs are positive integers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing comments, including share ID and optional sorting/pagination criteria.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a comment, including share ID and comment text.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a comment, including comment ID, share ID, and new text.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting a comment, requiring comment and share IDs.
